name: highcharts
note: Apache-2.0. Port each chart's options object to an ECharts option (series, xAxis, yAxis, tooltip).

name: highcharts-react-official
note: The wrapper itself is MIT, but it renders through the highcharts package, which the EULA covers. echarts-for-react is MIT.

name: highcharts-angular
note: The wrapper is MIT, but it renders through the highcharts package. ngx-echarts is MIT.

name: angular-highcharts
note: Third-party MIT wrapper; the charts still come from the highcharts package. ngx-echarts is MIT.

name: highcharts-vue
note: highcharts-vue points to Highsoft's own licence file. vue-echarts is MIT.

name: @highcharts/dashboards
note: Published under https://www.highcharts.com/license. ECharts has no dashboard layout package: place one echarts instance per cell of your own CSS grid.

name: highcharts-export-server
replace: echarts.init(null, null, { renderer: 'svg', ssr: true, width: 800, height: 400 }) then chart.renderToSVGString()
note: The export server is MIT but renders with the highcharts package. ECharts renders SVG on the server in Node without a browser.

name: @highcharts/map-collection
note: Map data ships under Highsoft's licence file. Load a GeoJSON file you are licensed to use and register it with ECharts.

name: @types/highcharts
note: A deprecated stub: highcharts ships its own types, and so does echarts.

name: @highcharts/grid-lite
replace: keep, after reading the Grid Lite EULA
note: The Highcharts EULA says Grid Lite is governed by its own Grid Lite EULA, not by the Highcharts one. It is not a chart and has no ECharts counterpart.

name: Highsoft.Highcharts
note: There is no Apache .NET package for ECharts. Remove the PackageReference and render the chart in the page from JSON your controller returns.

name: Highsoft.Highstock
note: Stock charts in ECharts are candlestick series plus dataZoom. Remove the PackageReference and render in the page.

name: code.highcharts.com
note: EULA 2.3: Highsoft may log CDN traffic, verify domains and crawl public sites to find unlicensed use.

name: highcharts
note: Covers highcharts, highcharts/highstock and highcharts/modules/* imports or require() calls.
